title: Multi-agent team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/multi-agent.yaml: the team layer of the multi-agent plugin's role map. A value here overrides the bundled default and the user-global file, and a personal .claude/multi-agent.local.yaml overrides it. Keys and resolution: plugins/multi-agent/reference/config.md. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

schema.description: The layer format version. The resolver skips a layer that declares any other value.

workloads.description: Workload declarations: true declares workload <w>, false withdraws it.

roles.description: Per-role model and effort. A role is orchestrator, worker, verifier or retrieval.

frontier.description: Comma-separated model aliases treated as frontier.

frontier_guard.description: When true, a fan-out stage that would run on a frontier model runs on fanout.model.

model.description: The model alias a guarded fan-out stage uses.

workloads.description: Per-workload overrides, keyed by a declared workload name.
